description: This file defines the Online model class for the Opencart catalog system, responsible for tracking online users by storing their IP address, URL, referer, and customer ID into the database. It contains the addOnline() method to record or update online user information, and uses database queries to manage the 'customer_online' table.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Model class for tracking online customer activity, extending the base Opencart Model class.

methods.name: addOnline
methods.description: Records online user information into the database, deleting expired records based on configuration setting and inserting or replacing current user data.
